# Software is communication

## A package carries our assumptions to every analyst who runs it

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- **Who runs ours.** The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention,
  UKHSA, the Robert Koch Institute and the World Health Organization
- **Users run the defaults**, so the defaults are the advice
- **The rest is support.** We meet analysts from health agencies and
  answer their questions
- In some cases the package is too complex for anyone else to use
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
| Package | Since | Stars | CRAN downloads |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| `EpiNow2` | 2020 | 141 | 58,073 |
| `epinowcast` | 2021 | 67 | not on CRAN |
| `epidist` | 2023 | 16 | not on CRAN |
| `primarycensored` | 2024 | 9 | 11,294 |
| `baselinenowcast` | 2025 | 10 | 1,678 |

## Defaults are advice

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- [EpiNow2](https://epiforecasts.io/EpiNow2/) has been on CRAN since
  1 September 2020
- **Every argument a user leaves alone is a decision they inherited
  from us**
- The generation time and the delays. The prior on $R_t$. The sampler
  settings
- The code on the right is the vignette. It is what gets copied
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
```r
estimates <- epinow(
  data = reported_cases,
  generation_time = gt_opts(example_generation_time),
  delays = delay_opts(example_incubation_period + reporting_delay),
  rt = rt_opts(prior = LogNormal(mean = 2, sd = 0.2)),
  stan = stan_opts(cores = 4)
)
```

::: {.attribution}
[EpiNow2 vignette](https://epiforecasts.io/EpiNow2/articles/EpiNow2.html) ·
[CRAN archive](https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/EpiNow2/),
1.1.0 on 1 September 2020
:::
:::
::::

## epinowcast. Communicating through a community

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- **[epinowcast](https://www.epinowcast.org/).** Researchers and public
  health analysts. 31 seminars from May 2023 to May 2026
- **A forum**, a monthly meeting with a rotating chair, release notes
  that name everyone who reported a bug or joined a discussion
- In 2023 I wrote: "I am also interested in why efforts in this
  direction keep failing"

> Trying to build a community of practice as community >> methods or
> models alone.
>
> *Abbott, 2023*
:::
